PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.CompanionMode.Name: Mobile Mode
PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.CompanionMode.Hint: Replace the normal Foundry UI on this browser session with a simplified touch-friendly sheet. Intended for a phone with no canvas. Only affects this client — other players are unaffected.
PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.KeepAwake.Name: Keep Screen Awake
PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.KeepAwake.Hint: Request a wake lock on this device so its screen doesn't sleep during play. Enable on your phone.
PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.Handedness.Name: Mobile Panel Handedness
PLAYONMOBILE.Settings.Handedness.Hint: Landscape only: which edge the dock and its tab sit on, and which hand's thumb drives it. The pan nib always lands on the opposite edge.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.NoActor: No character assigned to you. Choose one below.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.Settings.ThemeCol: Colors used for titles, resource values, and accents throughout the sheet.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.Settings.FastRoll: Skip a system's own roll-config dialog where possible. Only affects systems whose companion sheet declares a fast-forward shortcut.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.Settings.BlockDou: Prevent a quick double-tap on a token from opening its actor sheet. Recommended on touch, where accidental double-taps are common.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.Settings.LeaveTab: Log out of this session and return to the join screen. Useful when the app is installed as a PWA with no browser chrome to close it from.
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.LeaveTable.Confir: Log out and return to the join screen?
PLAYONMOBILE.Companion.UnsupportedSystem: This system isn't specially supported yet. Showing raw data only.
PLAYONMOBILE.MobileDetect.Title: Play on Mobile
PLAYONMOBILE.MobileDetect.Content: Looks like you're on a mobile device. Activate mobile mode?
